fields.label: Approval Stale Days
fields.description: Pending work older than this many days is flagged stale.

fields.label: Assistant manager step
fields.description: Assistant managers' tasks need a manager's approval before supervisors see them, and work on them is checked by the assistant manager before the manager approves it.

fields.label: Harvest Warehouse
fields.description: Harvested crates are received here by the Harvesting stock entry.

fields.label: Fallback Valuation per Kg
fields.description: Used when an item has no valuation rate or buyer price; 0 books the entry at zero valuation.

fields.label: Bands
fields.description: Colour thresholds for KPIs, sent to every page.

fields.label: Dry matter retest days
fields.description: A block is due for dry matter sampling when it is in or past its sampling stage and has no test in this many days.

fields.label: Fuel Warehouse
fields.description: Where the diesel for machine allocations is issued from (a Material Issue on submit).

fields.label: Feedlot Cost Center
fields.description: The cost centre a machine allocated to the Feedlot is charged to, unless the allocation names another.

fields.label: Silage Input Warehouse
fields.description: Default store seed, fertiliser, inoculant and sheeting are issued from to a silage cycle.

fields.label: Silage Pit Warehouse
fields.description: Default pit a closed silage cycle receives its silage into.

fields.label: Silage Labour Day Rate
fields.description: Pay per worker per day on a silage activity, used when the activity row gives no rate of its own.

fields.label: Labour Mode
fields.description: Automatic: when the Work Management app is installed, labour runs through it. Built-in only: production's own pay run, attendance and rate periods are always used.

fields.label: Pay Period
fields.description: How long a pay run covers; sets the default dates of a new pay run.

fields.label: Pay Week Starts On
fields.options:
Monday
Tuesday
Wednesday
Thursday
Friday
Saturday
Sunday
fields.description: First day of a weekly or fortnightly pay period.

fields.label: Pay Day
fields.options:
Monday
Tuesday
Wednesday
Thursday
Friday
Saturday
Sunday
fields.description: The weekday people are paid.

fields.label: Daily Wage
fields.description: One day's wage. A rate period with a daily target but no rate pays Daily Wage / Daily Target per unit.

fields.label: Duplicate Work
fields.description: Same person, date, operation and unit entered twice: Block refuses it, Warn flags it, Off ignores it.

fields.label: Several Jobs in a Day
fields.description: A person recorded on more than one job on the same date: Allow, Warn (flag it) or Block.

fields.label: Attendance Required
fields.description: When ticked, work can be recorded only for a day the person is marked Present or Half Day.

fields.label: Attendance Source
fields.description: Where attendance is read from: Casual Labour Attendance, HRMS submitted Attendance, or Both (either showing Present or Half Day counts).

fields.label: Max Backdate Days
fields.description: Work older than this many days is refused. 0 = no limit. Work dated in the future is always refused.

fields.label: Pay Reference Prefix
fields.description: Pay runs are numbered PREFIX-YEAR-00001.
